subject: POC trial environment setup: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@nimble-retail.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment setup: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC - recap & proposed next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet the Nimble Retail team. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before scheduling the kickoff: 

Success criteria (as discussed)
- Performance: sustain ~20 requests/sec for typical 512-token calls; p95 latency < 200ms for online inference.
- Cost: target <= $0.0005/token for the expected payload mix.
- Quality: parity with your current model responses on the 50-shot evaluation set (we'll run automated evals).
- Security/compliance: environment must meet your data isolation requirements; preference for VPC or dedicated sandbox with KMS-managed keys.

Evaluation plan
1) Baseline test (2 business days): run baseline on hosted environment to validate model and token accounting.
2) Dedicated sandbox (3–5 business days): reserved GPU pool with pinned model to validate throughput and latency under realistic load.
3) VPC trial (7–10 business days): private network onboarding, allowlist, and verification of audit logs and key management.

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff: Mon Aug 31 (or earliest available)
- Baseline: Aug 31–Sep 1
- Dedicated sandbox: Sep 2–Sep 6 (if you want us to reserve capacity earlier we can)
- VPC trial: Sep 7–Sep 16 (parallel work on network allowlist)

Ownership
- Redwood sales/POC: Marissa Cole (me) — overall coordination, MAP, SOW and trial terms.
- Infra/onboarding: Michael Grant — sandbox and VPC orchestration.
- Solutions architect: Vivek Kulkarni — prompt templates, eval setup, perf tests.
- Customer success: Rachel Kim — onboarding and day-to-day trial ops.

Requested items from Nimble Retail before kickoff
- A short sample dataset or representative payloads (S3 link or anonymized CSV).
- Network allowlist IPs and point-of-contact for VPC peering (if pursuing VPC).
- Security questionnaire answers (we can run this in parallel).

I've attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (Nimble_MVP_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our VPC onboarding checklist (vpc_onboarding_checklist.pdf) to make next steps concrete.

Please confirm which environment you'd like to prioritize (hosted -> dedicated sandbox -> VPC) and any procurement constraints. Once you confirm, Michael and Vivek will scope the infra tasks and I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0113

Subject: Re: POC trial environment setup: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC - recap & proposed next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Success criteria: confirmed. The performance and cost targets look reasonable; we'll validate against our 50-shot evaluation set.
- Priority: we would prefer to start with a dedicated sandbox to validate throughput quickly, but our security team will require a VPC trial before any production rollout. If we can do dedicated sandbox first and then a VPC week, that would be ideal.
- Timeline: procurement for sandbox access is likely fast; VPC will require our network team to coordinate (we'll need to schedule that).
- Owners: I'll be the primary from Nimble (Jordan Ellis); Sarah Patel (cc) will coordinate with our network/security team.

Can you and Michael send a proposed kickoff invite and an ETA on how quickly you can provision a dedicated sandbox? Also send any specific network info we should have ready for the VPC (CIDR, peering contact).

Appreciate it — excited to get started.

Best,
Jordan
Head of ML Engineering | Nimble Retail
jordan@nimble-retail.com

Confirmed plan
1) Kickoff meeting: Tue Sep 1, 10:00am PT — 30 min call to review success criteria and runbook.
2) Baseline on hosted: Sep 1–2 (quick checks, smoke tests).
3) Dedicated sandbox provisioned: Sep 3 (Michael to reserve capacity and share credentials).
4) Perf/scale tests: Sep 3–6 (Vivek to lead test harness).
5) VPC onboarding: Sep 7–16 (parallel work with Nimble network team).

Deliverables from Redwood
- MAP with milestones (attached).
- Sandbox credentials and test harness instructions.
- Shared eval dashboard and perf results.

Jordan — for the VPC we'll need:
- Contact person for peering (name + email + preferred hours).
- Allowlist CIDR(s) and any proxy requirements.
- If you have an internal SOC questionnaire, send it along and we'll respond within 48 hours.

I'll send the kickoff invite once Michael confirms the sandbox ETA. Attaching the HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.com/deal/NW-2026-045

Thanks all,
Marissa

Tasks for Vivek (SA)

- Prepare prompt templates and eval set mapping to their 50-shot test.

Rachel — please stand by to join kickoff and capture onboarding runbook items.

Let me know ETA for each item (put rough ETAs in a reply-all so Jordan sees them too). I'll send the kickoff invite once we have sandbox ETA.
